title: fmrireg 0.2.0
text: AR degrees freedom. fmri_lm() longer deflates residual degrees freedom AR structure used. previous adjustment multiplied n - p 1 / (1 + 2 * sum(1 - k/n)), variance inflation one obtain every autocorrelation equalled 1. never depended fitted AR coefficients — n = 200, p = 12, AR(1) returned 62.9 whether true autocorrelation 0.05 0.9 — applied top prewhitening, double-counting correction already made. changes reported AR p-values. become less conservative; degrees freedom roughly triple AR(1). previous behaviour cost statistical power rather inflating false positives, results significant remain significant, p-values power-sensitive analyses differ earlier versions. calculate_effective_df() gains working method = "satterthwaite" (previously verbatim duplicate method = "simple") computes tr(RV)^2 / tr(RVRV) supplied design post-whitening covariance, reducing exactly n - p errors uncorrelated. Residual correlation surviving filter legitimately costs degrees freedom; AR order .

title: fmrireg 0.2.0
text: Shared AR estimation now pools voxel residual autocovariances default instead fitting cross-voxel mean residual series. former targets typical voxel covariance; latter suppresses voxel-specific noise targets different, often autocorrelated coherent component. old behavior remains available explicitly noise_spec(..., shared_estimator = "mean_series"); collapsed-series mode omits OLS design correction voxel-level noise scale longer identifiable averaging. Design-corrected AR coefficients estimated initial OLS residuals held fixed GLS solve. Later GLS residuals different residual-forming operator longer reuse OLS design= correction. write_results(strategy = "by_stat") longer scatters contrast maps onto wrong voxels. .compute_statistical_volumes() called .logical() mask, drops dim plain arrays (type .fmri_dataset_mask_space() always supplies), (..., arr.ind = TRUE) returned linear indices instead 3D coordinates. Oversized residual-bootstrap blocks now remain one contiguous temporal block instead silently becoming interleaved odd/even samples. Mixed-model solver failures now warn return NA coefficients rather plausible zeros; malformed response dimensions fail solver dispatch. robust_psi now effect. previously unreachable: robust defaulted FALSE rather NULL, robust_options$type always claimed robust_psi consulted. robust’s default now NULL, also makes “unspecified” distinguishable “explicitly ”. explicit robust = FALSE longer silently overridden robust_options = list(type = "huber"); combination now error. Supplying cfg alongside configuration arguments now error instead silently discarding . Previously cor_struct = "ar2" cfg naming "iid" ran IID without warning. AR shorthands (cor_struct, cor_iter, cor_global, ar1_exact_first, ar_p, ar_voxelwise) disagree corresponding ar_options entry now error rather silently dropped. Shorthands agree still accepted. engine now warns execution arguments ignores (strategy, nchunks, use_fast_path, progress, parallel_voxels, parallel_chunks), previously accepted silently discarded. compute_sandwich_variance() computed meat matrix X' diag(e^4) X instead X' diag(e^2) X, giving standard errors 3.5x large. sandwich helpers now checked sandwich::vcovHC().

title: fmrireg 0.1.2

Consolidated duplicate meta-analysis pathways shared implementations removed inconsistent behavior across runwise/chunkwise pooling. Fixed F-contrast meta pooling combine evidence via p-values rather averaging F statistics. Fixed thread-safety issue C++ meta kernels deferring Paule-Mandel non-convergence warnings OpenMP regions. Added bounds validation safer inverse fallback sketch kernels prevent unsafe indexing hard failures ill-conditioned data. Fixed testthat API usage (expect_lt/expect_gt longer use deprecated info argument). Fixed latent_dataset API usage: now uses get_latent_scores() instead deprecated get_data(). Changed glm_lss() use_cpp parameter default TRUE FALSE (C++ implementation retired; fmrilss package now used). Added fmrireg.suppress_deprecation option check deprecated functions cleaner test output. Added tests/testthat/setup.R suppress expected deprecation warnings testing. Suppressed expected kmeans convergence warnings landmark SRHT tests.

title: fmrireg 0.1.0
text: column names now strictly follow format: term_tag + _ + condition_tag + [_b## basis suffix]. term_tag: Automatically generated variable names (e.g., var1_var2) user-provided id= hrf(), sanitized (dots become underscores), made unique # suffix needed (e.g., cond, cond#1). condition_tag: Represents factor levels (e.g., Factor.Level), continuous basis columns (e.g., poly_RT_01, z_RT), interactions joined _ (e.g., Factor.Level_poly_RT_01). _b##: Optional suffix added HRF multiple basis functions (e.g., _b01, _b02). previous style argument ("compact", "qualified", "uid") design_matrix() removed. single canonical format produced. Scripts analyses relied matching previous column name formats (e.g., using Var[Level], Var:Level, :basis[]) need updated use new term_tag_Condition.Tag_b## format.

title: fmrireg 0.1.0
text: Introduced new internal S3 class Reg representing regressors. main regressor() function now uses Reg internally maintains backward compatibility (returns class c("regressor", "Reg", "list")). Deprecated single_trial_regressor() null_regressor() favour using regressor() directly. Unified regressor evaluation evaluate.Reg S3 method, supporting different calculation methods (“fft”, “conv”, “loop”, “Rconv”). Evaluation methods now consistently use refactored evaluate.HRF HRF sampling. Refactored C++ evaluation code single wrapper (evaluate_regressor_cpp). Removed redundant internal helper functions (fastevalreg, fastevalreg2, conform_len, dots). Implemented autoplot.Reg (ggplot2) print.Reg (cli) methods, deprecating older plot.regressor print.regressor. Improved input validation recycling regressor() arguments using vctrs. Added optional sparse matrix output evaluate.Reg. Added memoization HRF sampling within evaluation.
